purpose: Capture distinct evidentiary roles in query m9-q042 without silently rewriting frozen benchmark labels or claiming one company implemented an end-to-end AI+shadow design.
original_question: How can immutable Big Data shadow comparisons be used to gate an agent-generated data migration?

required_facets.definition: First-party account of coding agents generating actual data consumer migration PRs, with explicit limitations and ownership of semantic validation.

case_support.claim: Honk created migration PRs for standardized dbt/BigQuery Runner, while ambiguous mappings and repositories lacking automated tests needed human review.

required_facets.definition: Two-sided set comparisons between legacy and replacement outputs from comparable immutable snapshot inputs.

case_support.claim: Netflix used C−M and M−C comparisons plus controlled fallback when replacing its Cassandra backup processing path; article does not claim this was an LLM-generated migration.

required_facets.definition: Define source and target snapshot/equivalence semantics, avoid unsupported automatic data mappings, hold rollout when validation or owner approval fails.

case_support.claim: Missing data-field mapping and tests necessitated explicit mapping instructions, owner approval, and exclusion of complex Scio consumers.
Two-sided shadow set differences under a declared comparison rule and fallback from the replacement path.

contextual_evidence.reason: Pre-production shadow, reverse shadow, checksum, row count and landing-latency gates support a data-ingestion migration, not an AI-generated code-migration claim.
Online mutable subscription migration used dual-write and shadow-read comparisons; useful for authority switching but not evidence of immutable Spark batch equivalence or generated PR safety.
End-to-end tier counting/auditing for Kafka message delivery, not a code-agent or immutable output-set migration.

baseline_diagnostic.implication: Top3 satisfies the agent-generated facet via Spotify but misses the primary immutable two-sided reconciliation facet. Flat hit@k against two author labels conflates this with a complete failure.
